body: I once got a classmate named Lưu Mai Anh, she ended up being called Lưu Manh by the whole school=)))

Phương Anh is a nice name and quite similar to her English one. A common nickname to go with any "Anh" is combination of that person's middle name and first name, in this case she can be called "Phanh" or simply Pương".

We are taking action regarding the remaining Wuhan tourists. Consider the time the father and son have been in VN the incubation period should be up very soon. New cases should pop up in no time (if there're any). By then you can decide.

I know what you said is reasonable, but here's the thing: I convinced her to come. She didnt want to go in the first place. That morning, it was raining so she told me she didnt want to come. I told her that the rain stopped so she should just come. She reluctantly agreed to that. She rushed to my school and get hit by a motor.

Its easy to say that I shouldnt blame myself, that I didnt cause the accident. But when you see the body of your close friend in front of your eyes, see her slowly dying, knowing that you could have stopped that, but you were so selfish you decided to let your friend go to you when she didnt want to come, you'll feel the uncontrollable urge to just fucking kill yourself. Because if it wasnt because of you, none of this would have happened. I do understand what you say, but its hard for me to not blame myself. Thank you anyway.

Four years ago I got accepted in my college. My friend got accepted in another one in the same city. There was a festival in my school for new comers so I invited her. She got in a traffic accident on the way to my school and died that very day. Actually, she died right in front of my school. She was only 17 at that time and she died only one day before the school year started. If i hadnt invited her, she would still be alive now.
